provenance.guardProof: The only scan-policy change activates when the current options key has an actual rejection. Every original nonempty rejection list was reevaluated, including stale lists from earlier options. An empty original list proves the first source-qualified candidate passed its actual checks: the new branch is never entered. All other runtime source and inputs are unchanged. The Gaussian guard excludes non-clamped buffers; every corpus camera frame is Uint8ClampedArray, with byte-equivalence regressions. Timing rows retain their original measurement run; initial-path timings predate the added retry guard, whose isolated overhead was not separately measured. Strict speed remains an unmet gate.

The final requested suite includes both hold APIs, actual tile draws, current-main Circle scans, and ordinary scene retirement.
